column1: # Which OGKM tags actually ship a public NVIDIA .run installer.
# WHY THIS EXISTS: sweep_plan.py used to choose driver versions from the 216
# supported OGKM tags alone. Publishing an open-gpu-kernel-modules tag and
# publishing a downloadable driver are DIFFERENT THINGS -- 87 of the 216 tags
# have no .run at either public path. A plan built without this file sends
# boxes to install drivers that cannot be obtained, and every one of them
# burns a rental and returns `driver-install-failed`. Observed 2026-08-30:
# Probed by range-requesting one byte of each candidate URL, in this order:
# AVAILABLE means one returned 200/206 and the third column is that URL.
# NOTE 403 != ABSENT. A rented box saw HTTP 403 for URLs that return 206 from a
# normal network, i.e. NVIDIA's CDN rate-limits/blocks some hosts. That is what
# --driver-cache is for: fetch here, upload to the box. Do not re-probe from a
# rented box and do not let a 403 rewrite this file.
